0x004925:
Formed in New Era 184, when ten space colonies united as an independent nation, by reorganizing the Earth Federation space forces stationed there. Nominally separate, it is effectively under Federation Army control (which some officers resent). Its demanding space combat role means its personnel are highly skilled.
In late New Era 186 it declared war on the Federation alongside the DC. Holding most spaceborne forces of the day, it quickly seized control of space, then supported DC ground operations. After commander Maier V. Branstein fell in battle it surrendered - in truth to prepare for the coming alien war, and many of its units joined 'Operation SRW,' the L5 Campaign's final operation.
Postwar its leaders were replaced and its name became a formality, but it still makes up most of Earth's space forces.
0x004EEB: A group from a parallel world, arriving via the transfer device 'System XN.' Once that world's Federation special-ops unit, they schemed after the <L5 Campaign>, backing the DC remnants' uprising. They sought to perfect System XN and prolong war with its mass-produced units and 'W Series' androids, but fell to the Hagane and Hiryu Custom.
0x005160:
Shura Gods are the weapons of the Shura, powered by their handlers' life energy. Ranks include 'Retsu,' 'Gou,' and 'Chou' class; the lowest, Retsu, can be piloted by any Shura with enough fighting spirit (life energy) and skill.
Gou- and Chou-class machines choose their riders: becoming one's handler demands strength, trials, and rites, and once a handler is chosen, no other can pilot it until that person dies. They are said to hold a will of their own, admitting only those they accept - an unqualified rider has their spirit drained and dies. Gou class and above were built with lost technology today's Shura cannot reproduce, so they are few; some have served for centuries, and several lie sealed, awaiting handlers.
A Gou-class handler holds respect and authority among the Shura, and piloting a Chou-class machine is required to become a Shura general. Retsu-class units are copies of surviving Gou-class machines - far weaker, but mass-producible.
0x0058A1:
A conflict waged by the 'Shura,' warriors from the otherworld Shura Realm. With that world nearing ruin, Alkaid, king of Ra, led the Shura aboard 'Tenku Majo' (Earth codename: Swordian), a giant sword-shaped structure able to cross dimensions, to seek a new home. Arriving after the <Inspector Incident>, they invaded Earth with the mobile weapons called the <Shura God>. Cities fell before the Hagane and Hiryu Custom raided the fortress in 'Operation Overgate,' defeating Alkaid with Folka Albark and others who had questioned the Shura way and sided with Earth.
Afterward Folka and the surviving Shura left aboard the fortress.
0x005D26:
A humanoid-weapon pilot training institution that once existed in the Federation Army, founded alongside the <Special Combat Skills Squad>. It first retrained conventional pilots for machines like the <Personal Trooper>, but its aim changed completely once Adler Koch took charge.
Rather than convert veterans, Adler sought pilots raised from the start for humanoid weapons. He secretly gathered children with no family and superior reflexes and dynamic vision, and had Dr. Agilla Setme of the Japan Special Neuromedical Research Institute erase and alter their memories. Through conditioning, drugs, and special training he tried to swiftly create humans specialized in piloting and combat: the 'Boosted Children.' They were sorted into metal-named classes - Aurum (gold), Argent (silver), Bronzo (bronze), Hierro (iron), Latooni (brass) - and adjusted for various roles.
Perhaps due to these forced methods, only a handful excelled. The inhumane program and its poor results became a scandal and the School was dissolved, but the Boosted Children's training continued under the <DC>.
0x0064BD: The Earth Federation's international military, built from the old-era UN Special Forces. While economics and administration remain inter-state affairs, it alone is unified globally, though each regional army keeps traits of the national forces it grew from.
0x00668B: A global political body that grew from a provisional UN organ amid the chaos after the AD 2012 meteor disaster ('Double Impact'). Though it stands above the existing nations as an international authority, it never unified all governance, and older regional conflicts carried over unresolved.
0x0068B8:
The title of semi-organic weapons ancient China created to fight the demons called the 'Hundred Evils.' They have minds of their own and can act alone, but show their true power only when piloted by a telekinetic they accept. Ordinary humans can board them, but their life force is drained - fatally, at worst.
Ranks include the 'Four Spirits,' 'Four Gods,' and 'Four Perils'; machines besides RyuKoOh and KoRyuOh likely exist, but details are unknown.
